decision_owner: Agent Reasoning Engine owner plus governance-model owner
decision_evidence: The owner selected both the plan-bound projector and the evidence-constrained interaction model: plan-bound continuation serves machine routing, while chat and human interaction may formulate additional proposals without granting them direct-continuation authority.

lanes.proposal_source: digest-bound continuation plan declared before completion
lanes.derivation_rule: Project only declared successor actions whose prerequisites and observed turn, item, and approval evidence reconcile.
lanes.effect_class_source: versioned plan metadata verified against the decision profile
lanes.direct_eligibility: eligible only when exactly one admissible proposal is reversible, non-consequential, non-protected, and not owner-gated
lanes.failure_behavior: unknown, conflicting, stale, or unplanned evidence gates or blocks

lanes.proposal_source: structured proposal created through agent, chat, or human interaction after completion
lanes.derivation_rule: Preserve the proposal as attributed candidate meaning and bind its claims to observed evidence; do not infer authority from prose.
lanes.effect_class_source: verified decision-profile classification over the normalized proposal, with unknown values preserved
lanes.direct_eligibility: never direct before an attributable human decision binds the exact proposal digest
lanes.failure_behavior: emit a decision gate for human clarification or selection; block when identity, evidence, or selected dependencies are missing

merge_rule: Evaluate both lanes in one continuation assessment. Interaction-bound proposals always force gate; multiple surviving proposals across either lane force gate; only one safe plan-bound proposal with no interaction-bound proposal may be direct.
opens: candidate dual-lane continuation contracts and DomainSpec source
bounded adapter design for deterministic proposal normalization and projection
negative tests proving interaction prose cannot yield direct continuation
does_not_open: Product Capability adoption, conformance, publication, release, deployment, or effect authority
claim_limit: Owner selection of candidate continuation-source semantics only; it does not implement the projector or adapter and does not authorize any successor effect.
